name: x11-amplify-no-block-inferior
about: v189: The LuminousBrilliance Pepper's Tyranno (26RBS02-X11, LV1-2) (Your Attack Step): 'When your "Leucomyst" family Spirit activates Amplify, during this battle, all your Spirits can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with BP equal or inferior to theirs.' = AMPLIFY trigger with match.family Leucomyst (the amplifying Spirit is the trigger subject; AMPLIFY filters by e.match), if {step ATTACK, oppTurn false}, action NO_BLOCK_INFERIOR_BATTLE: every own Spirit carries noBlockInferiorBattle = battleNo, read by blockedByMark (08-battle block list). The LV2 Invoke is the usual Amplify per-count BP_TARGET.
